name: @salon/shared
description: Code shared across the web front ends. TWO SUBPATHS WITH DIFFERENT RULES: './config' is SERVER/BUILD-TIME ONLY and must never reach a browser bundle (it carries a window tripwire and is the target of the 6c client-import lint gate); './chat' is BROWSER-SAFE BY DESIGN — the widget transport imported by both web/site and web/snippet, framework-free, no process.env, no Node built-ins. The old blanket 'server-only' wording was corrected in Phase 6b when './chat' was added: a package-wide claim that is false for one subpath is worse than none.
